title: Design: the New Matrix page and its category picker
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin whose role has 'Settings — Parts' and 'See Financial Data'.
  • Use a desktop browser window exactly 1440 pixels wide, at 100% zoom, so the screen matches the design pictures' size.
custom_steps:
1. Click the Matrices tab on Settings › Pricing.
  2. Click New Matrix.
  3. Click the Categories picker.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The Matrices list shows with a blue New Matrix button.

Step 2:

  • A large name field with the placeholder "Matrix name" shows, with "Inactive: No categories use this matrix" in gray beside it.
  • Cancel and a blue Create Matrix sit at the top right.
  • A picker labelled "Categories (0)" reads "Choose categories".
  • The grid has one range "$0.00 and up"; Default's picker reads Markup % and each tier's Previous tier; the empty cells are outlined in red, as in picture 3.22.

Step 3:

  • A list opens with "Search categories", "0 selected" and a checkbox per category.
  • Categories on another matrix show "Now:" and the matrix name in gray at the right, as in picture 3.23.
